commands.command:
/bin/bash -lc "cat > candidate.lean <<'EOF'
open OldExpressions in
theorem substOldPostSubset:
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression)
    (substOld h2 (Lambda.LExpr.fvar m h1 ty) post)).Subset
    (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression) post ++ [h1]) := by
  have join {a b c d : List Expression.Ident}
      (ha : a.Subset (c ++ [h1])) (hb : b.Subset (d ++ [h1])) :
      (a ++ b).Subset ((c ++ d) ++ [h1]) := by
    intro x hx
    simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton] at *
    cases hx with
    | inl hx => cases ha hx with
      | inl hx => exact Or.inl (Or.inl hx)
      | inr hx => exact Or.inr hx
    | inr hx => cases hb hx with
      | inl hx => exact Or.inl (Or.inr hx)
      | inr hx => exact Or.inr hx
  induction post <;>
    simp [substOld, Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at *
  case fvar => simp [List.subset_def]
  case abs ih => exact ih
  case ite cih tih eih => exact join cih (join tih eih)
  case quant trih eih => exact join trih eih
  case eq ih1 ih2 => exact join ih1 ih2
  case app ih1 ih2 =>
    split
    · split
      · simp [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars, List.subset_def]
      · simpa [Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] using ih2
    · simpa only [Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] using join ih1 ih2
EOF
python check_candidate.py candidate.lean"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -i 's/simp only \\[List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton\\] at \\*/simp only [List.subset_def, List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton] at */' candidate.lean
python check_candidate.py candidate.lean"

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
p='candidate.lean'
s=open(p).read(); a=s.index('    simp only'); b=s.index('  induction post'); s=s[:a]+'''    apply List.mem_append.mpr
    cases List.mem_append.mp hx with
    | inl hx => cases List.mem_append.mp (ha hx) with
      | inl hx => exact Or.inl (List.mem_append.mpr (Or.inl hx))
      | inr hx => exact Or.inr hx
    | inr hx => cases List.mem_append.mp (hb hx) with
      | inl hx => exact Or.inl (List.mem_append.mpr (Or.inr hx))
      | inr hx => exact Or.inr hx
'''+s[b:]; open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
python check_candidate.py candidate.lean"

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
p='candidate.lean';s=open(p).read().replace('simp [substOld, Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at *','simp only [substOld, Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at *').replace('case fvar => simp [List.subset_def]','case fvar => intro x hx; simpa using Or.inl hx\\n  case op => exact List.nil_subset _\\n  case const => exact List.nil_subset _\\n  case bvar => exact List.nil_subset _').replace('simpa using Or.inl hx','exact List.mem_append.mpr (Or.inl hx)').replace('simp [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars, List.subset_def]','simp [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]\\n        intro x hx\\n        simp_all');open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
python check_candidate.py candidate.lean"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -i 's/join cih (join tih eih)/join (join cih tih) eih/' candidate.lean
python check_candidate.py candidate.lean"

method_note: Shell commands and visible correctness outcomes only; no reasoning text. rg/sed is a literal command-presence indicator, not a semantic retrieval score.
